name: flow_generate
description: Queue one clip or image per scene in the open Flow project. Runs one at a time with human-like pauses and spends the user's Google AI credits (approx. per video: Omni 1.1 Flash 7-12, Veo 3.1 Lite 10, Fast 20, Quality 100; images 0). Each scene is checked against max_credits using Flow's own quote before anything is spent. Returns job ids immediately; use flow_wait for results.

project.description: Folder name for the downloaded clips, e.g. 'HotelPromo'.

chain_previous.description: Continue the previous scene in this call: its last frame becomes this scene's first frame. Not valid on the first scene or together with first_frame.

download_quality.description: 'upscaled' fetches 1080p video / 2K image (free, slower). Default original.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Omni models only; Veo 3.1 clips are fixed at 8s.

first_frame.description: First frame: absolute image path, or 'asset:<title>' for an image already in the Flow project.

last_frame.description: Last frame: absolute image path, or 'asset:<title>'.

max_credits.description: Safety cap: the scene is skipped (nothing spent) if Flow quotes more credits than this.

model.description: Model label as shown in Flow, e.g. 'Omni 1.1 Flash', 'Veo 3.1 - Fast', 'Veo 3.1 - Quality', 'Nano Banana 2'. Omit to keep Flow's current model.

prompt.description: Full English prompt for one clip: action, shot and camera move, location, style, light, sound.

reference_images.description: Reference media: absolute image paths, or 'asset:<title>' for media or characters already in the Flow project. Flow's COMPOSER takes references OR first/last frames on a video scene, never both, so with frames set these are skipped and the job says so. Flow itself can do both via agent mode (save the last frame, Animate it, then add the character).

reference_previous.description: Use the previous scene's finished image as an extra reference, so this scene inherits its exact drawing of the characters, style and palette. Best way to keep a set of stills on-model.

retries.description: Automatic retries when Flow itself reports the generation failed.

technique.description: Id from flow_techniques (e.g. 'orbit-360'); its exact phrase is appended to the prompt. One per scene.

variants.description: Outputs per prompt (each one spends credits). Default 1.
